description_zh: 测试车辆在手动模式下行驶时撞上路面碎片，碎片弹起刮伤了驾驶员侧车门，未涉及其他车辆或道路使用者，属于单车撞静止物体，无第二交互参与者。
reason: 属于 non-collision（撞物体），无第二参与者，无任何移动的车辆具备测试价值。

source_snippets: On February 22nd, a test vehicle operating in manual mode was traveling East-bound on Evelyn Avenue in Mountain View and ran over road debris that was projected upward, scratching the test-vehicle’s driver-side door.
